validation_workflow: 1. Check value type (IRI, LITERAL, BNODE) if specified
2. Check allowed IRIs set if non-empty
3. If LITERAL, extract content and language/datatype
4. Apply language tag constraints if present
6. Apply numeric range if datatype is numeric
10. Return true only if all constraints pass
